sourceLabels.WIKISOURCE_TRANSCRIPTION: Accessible transcription, not a scanned/verified printed edition
sourceLabels.SECONDARY: Modern commentary/educational website, not historically authenticated
sourceLabels.SECONDARY_BOOK_TRANSCRIPTION: Online attributed commentary; edition and attribution should be validated

records.name: Anh Tinh Nhập Miếu
records.researchFinding: 108s states Phá Quân alone at Tý/Ngọ is the basic pattern; strict noble-grade requires favorable year/transformations and no disruptive stars. Astroverse likewise distinguishes positional test from original verse with 無殺.
records.adjudicationInstruction: Separate basic formation from quý cách. Ask whether Grok compared full noble grade while Terra compared structural recognition. Do not add all favorable conditions to base rule.

records.name: Hình Kỵ Giáp Ấn
records.researchFinding: 108s explicitly identifies school-level differences: some schools use 羊陀夾天相, their school instead has 天相化忌 with 擎羊. Lu Bin Zhao commentary gives 擎羊 + 化忌 in flanking palaces as formal pattern; another 天梁 variant.
records.adjudicationInstruction: This is a REAL SCHOOL VARIANT; record separate formulas with source+school, not consensus one rule. Distinguish 刑忌夾印 from 刑囚夾印.

records.name: Nhật Nguyệt Tật Ách
records.researchFinding: PR19 source says Sun + Moon at 疾厄; Hóa Kỵ is not in the bound passage. Wikisource chapter 二/六疾厄 can serve as secondary context but not prove a named 日月疾厄格.
records.adjudicationInstruction: Challenge Hóa Kỵ as mandatory; distinguish named pattern, palace placement, and interpretive consequences. Require a second exact-definition source before claiming historical identity.

records.name: Sát Phá Tham
records.researchFinding: Both pages describe 七殺 破軍 貪狼 as a three-way geometric system; Astroverse explicitly says a dedicated 古書賦 line was not located. The three stars always form a 삼합 structural group.
records.adjudicationInstruction: Separate stellar-system geometry from contingent wealth/eminence conditions; test whether the rule is tautological with respect to the stars and whether Mệnh must fall into their three houses.

records.name: Thạch Trung Ẩn Ngọc
records.researchFinding: Wikisource 卷一 女命骨髓賦 appended patterns: 論石中隱玉格 命在子午逢巨門是也; the following poem adds 得三方科祿照. 108s labels Cự Môn at Tý/Ngọ basic; Lộc/Quyền and no sát for quý cách.
records.adjudicationInstruction: STRONG primary-transcription evidence for two-tier interpretation: basic=巨門命宮子午; upgrade=三方科祿. Determine exactly which category model A/B compared, do not collapse.

records.name: Thiên Ất Củng Mệnh
records.researchFinding: 108s formation is 天魁+天鉞 in Mệnh 三方四正; it contrasts with 坐貴向貴 and does not require both in 命/遷 specifically. Wikisource mentions 魁鉞同行, but not necessarily title 天乙拱命.
records.adjudicationInstruction: Compare geometric pattern vs narrower opposite-palace version; do not derive exact historical title from the older generic phrase.

records.name: Tử Phủ Vũ Tướng
records.researchFinding: A modern encyclopedia defines a four-star constellation meeting in 三方四正; 108s details 紫府朝垣 which is a DIFFERENT named pattern. No primary defining passage for the exact title was verified.
records.adjudicationInstruction: Treat 108s as related, not identity proof. Establish exact identity by a named source; test each star placement using diagram instead of inferring it from a title. Do not force MATCH.

records.name: Văn Tinh Củng Mệnh
records.chineseSearchTerm: 文星拱命 / 文星朝命
records.researchFinding: Primary transcription at 卷一: 論文星朝命格 followed by 文昌文曲 most glorious + further 三方 favorable stars. Modern pattern treats 文昌/文曲 in Mệnh three-way aspects as base; extra auspicious condition differs.
records.adjudicationInstruction: Investigate 朝命↔拱命 as edition/school alias, separate two 文星 from additional 吉星 strength. Check whether same-palace requires separate subvariant.

records.name: Bán Không Chiết Xỉ
records.chineseSearchTerm: 半天折翅 / 半空折翅
records.researchFinding: The wording actually found is 生逢天空，猶如半天折翅, inside 命里逢空 discussion. B3 name Bán Không Chiết Xỉ diverges from 折翅 (wings broken), and this text does not define an independent named pattern with that label.
records.adjudicationInstruction: Keep NAME_MISMATCH. Research whether Vietnamese phrase should be 半天折翅, not 半空折齒; if unsupported, deprecate/rename catalog label in separate approved proposal, not change rule in current PR.

records.name: Lộ Bàng Mai Thi
records.researchFinding: Wikisource 太微賦 explicitly says 七殺廉貞同位，路上埋屍. The old phrase itself does not say Sửu/Mùi or Hóa Kỵ; modern explanation says 廉貞+七殺 can occupy Sửu/Mùi and later comments add 落陷 化忌 as worsening.
records.adjudicationInstruction: Resolve condition-list disagreement by tagging 廉殺同位 as literal formation; Sửu/Mùi as derived astronomical consequence requiring star-placement proof; 化忌 as commentary/strengthening not a requirement in this quoted sentence.

records.name: Mệnh VCD Đắc Tam Không
records.chineseSearchTerm: 無正曜 得三空 / 三空
records.researchFinding: PR19 bound source expects Vô Chính Diệu, Tuần/Triệt and Thiên Không aspect; other Đắc/Ngộ/Kiến variants use different definitions. Related Mệnh里逢空 cannot prove 得三空; definitions vary.
records.adjudicationInstruction: Model discrepancy thien_khong_aspect is likely classification of aspect vs presence. Make evidence matrix distinguishing Đắc/Ngộ/Kiến and explicit required no-major. Preserve school variants if still inconsistent.

records.name: Nhật Nguyệt Tịnh Minh
records.chineseSearchTerm: 日月並明 / 丹墀桂墀
records.researchFinding: 108s defines base as both 太陽 and 太陰 in 廟旺 within Mệnh 三方四正 and lists several configurations; extra Lộc/昌曲 pertains to quý cách.
records.adjudicationInstruction: Compare source to runtime by brightness and geometry, not assumption Sun+Moon must share palace. Tân Biên separate edition still needs page verification.

records.name: Cự Nhật Đồng Cung
records.researchFinding: 108s gives 太陽+巨門 same palace at 寅/申? Page description includes 寅/未 wording that needs internal consistency check; ancient phrase 巨日同宮官封三代 is cited.
records.adjudicationInstruction: Do not promote disputed branch 寅/未/申 without independent astronomical check; verify possible positions by the star algorithm/secondary diagram; differentiate physical co-location from bright-grade.

records.name: Thất Sát Triều Đẩu
records.researchFinding: 108s defines 七殺 Mệnh 寅/申 opposite 紫微天府 for base; additional 吉星 define high grade. Separate 寅 vs 申 relative Sun/Moon brightness.
records.adjudicationInstruction: Check if baseline Tân Biên formula requires another position and whether source references 仰斗 separately; annotate this as school/edition difference, not blanket conflict.

records.name: Tham Vũ Đồng Hành
records.researchFinding: 108s describes 武曲/貪狼 combinations and differentiates 火鈴貪 alternatives; an exact defining passage of Tham Vũ Đồng Hành in Tân Biên has not been rechecked against PDF.
records.adjudicationInstruction: Require same-palace vs hội chiếu distinction from exact local source; use modern page as lead only.

records.name: Mã Lạc Không Vong
records.researchFinding: 108s defines 天馬 meeting 地空/地劫 same palace or opposite, while Wikisource 太微賦 says 馬遇空亡，終身奔走. One is shorthand, the other explanatory formula.
records.adjudicationInstruction: Break into exact aphorism, candidate operational predicates, and named formal pattern. Do not infer same-palace requirement exclusively from the aphorism.

records.name: Tử Phủ Triều Viên
records.researchFinding: 108s gives eight chart configurations and distinguishing criteria; other book-commentary site narrows explicit roles of 紫微/天府 relative to 命.
records.adjudicationInstruction: Compare four/eight cases separately and distinguish 紫府朝垣 from 紫府同宮 and 紫府武相.

records.name: Nhật Nguyệt Đồng Lâm
records.researchFinding: 108s defines 太陽+太陰 same palace 丑/未; auspicious stars and no 殺忌 concern noble grade.
records.adjudicationInstruction: Check if original Tân Biên formula at 19.2.14 matches shared palace/branches; distinguish name from broad Sun/Moon aspect.

records.name: Hình Tù Giáp Ấn
records.researchFinding: Sources support 廉貞+天相+擎羊 in Mệnh 子/午. The term 夾 is conventional even though stars cohabit; this is NOT 刑忌夾印, whose structure varies by school.
records.adjudicationInstruction: Use exact Chinese characters 囚 vs 忌; never merge with Hình Kỵ Giáp Ấn. Test same-palace + location separately from neighboring-flank.

records.name: Nhật Lệ Trung Thiên
records.researchFinding: Both 108s and Wikisource 太微賦 state 太陽居午; 108s further lists additional 吉祥 as quý-grade/strengthening not recognition.
records.adjudicationInstruction: If conflict over missing auspicious stars, split base=Sun Mệnh Ngọ versus quý-grade=meet stars. Original PDF page still unverified.

records.name: Kình Dương Nhập Miếu (Mã Đầu Đới Tiễn)
records.chineseSearchTerm: 擎羊入廟 / 馬頭帶箭 / 馬頭帶劍
records.researchFinding: 108s 擎羊入廟: 擎羊 alone at Mệnh 丑辰未戌. 馬頭帶箭: selected Mệnh 午 with year conditions. 馬頭帶劍: 108s says a DIFFERENT, usually unfavorable grouping. The three names must not be forcibly aliased.
records.adjudicationInstruction: P0 identity split. Kình Dương N.M. is not simply Mã Đầu Đới Tiễn. Recheck Tân Biên PDF and stored digest; do not coerce to a single combination.

supplementalWarnings.name: Thủy Trừng Quế Ngạc
supplementalWarnings.note: Wikisource aphorism only requires Thái Âm at Tý; modern 月生滄海 gloss adds Thiên Đồng with Thái Âm at Tý. Strong evidence of two source-level definitions, not one objectively superior runtime rule.

supplementalWarnings.name: Hoa Cái Cư Phu Thê
supplementalWarnings.note: B3 catalog required_stars incorrectly lists Hóa Kỵ while pattern name and source refer to Hoa Cái. This is a catalog inconsistency, even without historical named-pattern confirmation.

supplementalWarnings.name: Lưỡng Trùng Thiên Mã
supplementalWarnings.note: Two Lộc + one Mã != two Thiên Mã; keep NAME_MISMATCH and separate possible 疊馬/流馬 concepts.

supplementalWarnings.name: Tài Ấn Giao Trì
supplementalWarnings.note: Modern label found but snippet omits Mệnh and Thiên Tướng. Do not claim a Vũ Tướng 同宮 rule based on that snippet.

supplementalWarnings.name: Khúc Ám Đồng Cung
supplementalWarnings.note: The readable line supports Văn Khúc+Cự Môn đồng cung only; not meeting-by-aspect or exact historic title.
